generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, these habits are the foundation of independent research across the School of Sport. Each literature review you scope, each specialist database you search rather than settle for the first results, each study you weigh and justify, is this craft at work. It is also what research and professional practice in sport reward: the ability to find the evidence that matters, judge its quality, and stand behind your choices, whether you work in a lab, on a training pitch, in a clinic or in sport policy.
